import math
from build123d import *

# ---------- named parameters (read from the drawing) ----------
OD = 60.0            # mm  outer diameter (top view "⌀60", "30" = radius)
ID = 48.0            # mm  inner through hole ("⌀48 THRU")
H  = 88.0            # mm  overall height (front view overall)
X_OVERALL = 69.5     # mm  overall X incl. side boss (top view)
BOSS_Z = 40.0        # mm  side-boss center height (front view)
N_HOLES = 10         #     "10×"
HOLE_D = 4.0         # mm  "⌀4"
HOLE_DEPTH = 12.0    # mm  "↓ 12"  (blind, from bottom face)
BC_D = 54.0          # mm  "ON ⌀54 BC"
CHAM = 0.5           # mm  "C0.5" on boss tip (two callouts)
BOSS_W = 12.0        # mm  boss width in Y (read from 1:1 right/top views)
BOSS_H = 12.0        # mm  boss height in Z (read from 1:1 front/right views)

# ---------- derived values ----------
R_OUT = OD / 2.0                 # 30
R_IN  = ID / 2.0                 # 24
R_BC  = BC_D / 2.0               # 27 (mid-wall)
R_HOLE = HOLE_D / 2.0            # 2
X_LEFT = -R_OUT                  # -30 (leftmost of OD)
X_TIP  = X_LEFT + X_OVERALL      # +39.5 boss tip (69.5 overall)
X_ROOT = R_IN                    # embed boss to inner wall (r never < 24)
BOSS_LEN_X = X_TIP - X_ROOT      # box length in X
BOSS_CX = (X_ROOT + X_TIP) / 2.0 # box center in X

with BuildPart() as bp:
    # tube: outer cylinder minus through bore
    Cylinder(radius=R_OUT, height=H, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))
    Cylinder(radius=R_IN,  height=H, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN),
             mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # 10 blind holes from the bottom face, equally spaced on the bolt circle,
    # first hole on +X so section A-A (X axis) cuts the 0 deg / 180 deg holes
    for k in range(N_HOLES):
        a = math.radians(k * 360.0 / N_HOLES)   # 0,36,72,... (symmetric about X and Y)
        with Locations((R_BC * math.cos(a), R_BC * math.sin(a), 0.0)):
            Cylinder(radius=R_HOLE, height=HOLE_DEPTH,
                     align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN),
                     mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # rectangular side boss on +X, centered at Y=0, Z=BOSS_Z
    with Locations((BOSS_CX, 0.0, BOSS_Z)):
        Box(BOSS_LEN_X, BOSS_W, BOSS_H,
            align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER))

    # C0.5 chamfers on the two outer vertical edges of the boss tip.
    # The only Z-parallel linear edges of the solid are the boss-tip pair;
    # group them along X and take the max-X group (no Vector component access).
    z_edges = bp.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z)
    if len(z_edges) > 0:
        tip_edges = z_edges.group_by(Axis.X)[-1]
        chamfer(tip_edges, length=CHAM)

part = bp.part
export_step(part, "output.step")
